shared_contract.compatibility: An explicit source-preserving projection can satisfy minimum inputs; native M1-M10 JSON is not claimed to be directly interchangeable.
shared_contract.effects: Read explicit JSON, compute deterministic results and print JSON; no input writes, network, media decoding, H3 inference or external module execution.
shared_contract.technical_retry: Replay the exact accepted request and proposal; immutable receipts make the retry idempotent.
shared_contract.creative_revision: Use a new request_id and the current state base_version; keep the source ID/version/content relation consistent.
shared_contract.semantic_boundary: The Agent prepares and reviews approved semantics; the script checks explicit structures and declarations. Neither route readiness nor contract validity proves an external fact or media outcome.

failure_owners.asset_identity_reference_permission: M2 or the authorized external source

modules.responsibility: 核对原请求并原子接受独占子分区，维护 CompilationResult 的版本、来源、收据和实际依赖失效；不重写上游创作语义。

dependencies.required_child_count: Only the child results submitted for this invocation; other partitions may remain absent.

route.trigger: Accept one or more child results for the same work and base version.
route.input_mapping: Explicit state, original request set and proposal set; no implicit retrieval or child execution.
preconditions: Exclusive partitions, versions, source records and supplied dependencies agree
route.success_return: New partial or compiled_unexecuted state, or identical state for an exact replay.
route.failure_return: Structured ContractError; no partial acceptance or input mutation.
route.branch_priority: Explicit submitted scope; independent children do not force unrelated children to run.

parent_acceptance.source_version_reuse: reject changed content under the same source ID/version
parent_acceptance.request_id_reuse: reject a different accepted revision under a previous request_id

invalidation.actual_mechanism: accept checks source readers and profile/binding/compilation fingerprints, then propagates stale through those supplied dependencies.
invalidation.impact_helper: impact reports JSON paths that changed and requests review; it does not infer semantic dependency or invoke a consumer.
invalidation.external_consumers: M12 and the execution caller receive the result explicitly; this adapter does not activate or track external consumers.

modules.responsibility: 固定目标后端、模型、工作流和协议版本，将协议语法与有证据的运行能力分别登记。

optional_inputs: Documented runtime field and range evidence
dependencies.replacement: Compatible caller or external evidence projection
dependencies.unknown_runtime: May produce a protocol-only profile; cannot authorize an executable task export.

official_mapping.labels: No new model Label; determines the pinned grammar and runtime support relevant to the existing labels.

route.trigger: Capability preflight, version change or missing runtime mapping
preconditions: Protocol version supported by this compiler
route.failure_return: Version/evidence diagnostic to caller; no guessed limits

modules.invalidation: Changed source or profile fingerprints require review of the actual dependent binding, compilation and task export.

modules.responsibility: 按资产真实角色选择模式，生成独立的素材、Subject、Shot 与 S 编号，保留参考作用域和音频策略。
readonly: M2 reference roles and identity authority

optional_inputs: Applicable subjects, standalone visual references, audio bindings and speakers
dependencies.replacement: Self-contained compatible external declarations; irrelevant collections are explicitly empty.

official_mapping.requirements: Role precedes mode; independent namespaces; no unrequested synchronized audio; no identity-only image promoted to a keyframe.

route.trigger: Mode selection, asset ordering or reference-label audit
preconditions: Unambiguous roles and local shot timeline
Defined source refs and asset versions
route.failure_return: Role, source, sound or time conflict to its owner; no automatic story change

modules.invalidation: Changed actual binding invalidates compilation and exports that depend on its fingerprint; unrelated external inputs are not silently rewritten.

modules.responsibility: 将已协调英文片段、原台词及必保信息编译为本模式精确字段与纯提示词，并独立输出引用和语义追溯。
readonly: Approved M1-M10 or external semantic fragments
forbidden_writes: Omitted actions to fit arbitrary length

optional_inputs: Original dialogue, cross-shot speech and visible text declarations
dependencies.replacement: A compatible external binding can be supplied directly without invoking M11.1 or M11.2.

route.trigger: Compile or audit current H3 prompt fields
preconditions: All declared shots and obligations covered
Verbatim content and stable reference tokens available
route.failure_return: Exact protocol or missing-obligation diagnostic; semantic conflict returns to owner

modules.invalidation: Changed compiled content invalidates task exports that consumed that compilation; text meaning remains an Agent review obligation.

modules.responsibility: 将计划参数和编译结果映射到明确版本的实际工作流字段，输出任务包和独立映射证据；不执行生成。

dependencies.replacement: Compatible external compilation/profile can be supplied directly
dependencies.unknown_runtime: Return runtime_unknown; keep the compilable prompt and original requested targets for the caller.

official_mapping.labels: Consumes the exact compilation and media label/channel order; runtime field names are not H3 prompt Labels.

route.trigger: Runtime parameter mapping or task export
preconditions: Parameter mapping evidence and exact units
route.failure_return: Specific missing or incompatible runtime field to caller; no fabricated runnable workflow

modules.invalidation: A change to the consumed profile, compilation, parameter evidence or asset version requires an explicit new export.
